# Application compatibility

The catalog under `applications/` covers major free/open-source application families rather than embedding whole distributions. Entries describe upstream source, license, native languages, supported platforms, integration mode and sandbox expectations.

Initial families include file managers, terminals, office/document suites, image/PDF tools, media players, browser/WebKit shells, archives, calculators, system monitors, disk/network/developer tools, accessibility, recording, backup/synchronization and package-management interfaces.

`native` means a Chimera-native or directly portable implementation; `wrapped` means an adapter around a platform capability; `fetched` means source can be staged through the secure acquisition layer; `reference` means the project is used as a behavioral/UI/API reference. None of these modes authorize silent execution or installation.
